verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an in-product AI chatbot that queries CRM records, summarizes them and explains your data in natural language. Its AI overview also lists opportunity scoring based on engagement patterns, which is a data-derived insight. Missing for 10: documentation of proactive, unprompted suggestions or recommendations surfaced in the UI, depth on how scoring works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The AI chatbot can query your CRM records, summarize information, and help you find what you're looking for without building complex filters.
Ask questions in natural language and the assistant retrieves and explains your CRM data for you.
Score opportunities based on engagement patterns
AI agents that work autonomously within your CRM — answering questions, enriching records, and executing multi-step tasks within your permission model.
